# A Letter to Marram Cove

*Brisa's midwinter letter to her parents travels inland by way of Marram Cove. She asks you to carry it there, and the road is full of dune cats.*

## Objectives

1. Reach [Marram Cove](../maps/marram_cove.md)
2. Defeat 20 [Dune Cat](../monsters/dune_cat.md)
3. Bring 10 [Dune Cat Fur](../items/dune_cat_fur.md) (taken)
